# Preface {.unnumbered}

The [Cyber Expertise Diversity Survey](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/cross_fac/cim/research/cyber_expertise_diversity) is a project run by the [Centre for Interdisciplinary Methodologies](https://warwick.ac.uk/cim) and the [Research Institute for Sociotechnical Cyber Security (RISCS)](https://riscs.org.uk), led by Matt Spencer, RISCS Senior Fellow and Associate Professor at CIM.

Other CIM staff involved in putting the survey together and analysing the data include Carlos Cámara-Menoyo and Timothy Monteath.

The survey aims to inform cyber policy discussions by generating new insights into the value and distribution of cyber expertise.
